en.t: Actually, I have come to ask you for a favor...

units.source_text: 本来我是没有资格提出这种要求的，是我多管闲事。

en.t: Strictly speaking, I have no right to make such a request; I am simply meddling in matters that are not my business.

units.source_text: 能不能把明天的对局改为后天进行呢？

en.t: Would it be possible to move tomorrow's game to the day after tomorrow?

units.source_text: 大竹先生说，希望能延后一天，

en.t: Mr. Otake says he hopes it can be postponed by one day,

units.source_text: 他带到旅馆里来的那个小儿子生病，高烧不退，

en.t: because the little son he brought with him to the inn has fallen ill and his high fever will not come down,
so Mr. Otake is very worried.

units.source_text: 听说大竹本人也拉肚子……”

en.t: I hear that Otake himself also has diarrhea..."
